thread:
sahil: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for release v2.4.1-rlz. Plan: EU canary (5% traffic) -> US staggered slices -> APAC warm-pool then open. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency >1200ms. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v2.4.1

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary start: service=frontend variant=v2.4.1-rlz region=eu slices=1/20 timestamp=3334445560

elaine: Quick capacity scrub: EU reserved pool has 8 Gpu nodes free, warm-pool at 30% primed. Should be ok for 5% canary. I'll watch KV cache hit rates.

kai: Note: background batch jobs in EU run at 02:15 UTC; we'll temporarily throttle them during ramp to avoid noisy neighbors.

ops-oncall: ETA for observability dashboards to show canary metrics? I want p50/p95, error-rate, token throughput, and infra OOMs.

elaine: Dashboards wired, alerts set. Alert thresholds: error-rate >=1.5% -> #ops-alerts, p95 >=1200ms -> #ops-alerts. I'm adding a transient alert for KV miss spike >10%.

maria: Any pinned versions for dependent services? We should pin reranker to 1.9.0-compat for this rollout.

sahil: Good catch — pin reranker=1.9.0-compat in the rollout config. Also canary has a safe-fallback to v2.3.9 if errors spike.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary health update: region=eu, duration=8m, error-rate=0.3%, p95=420ms, cpu=62%, gpu_mem=56%. Status=GREEN.

kai: EU canary looks healthy. Proceed to US staggered slices at 10% -> 30% over 45m. Ops, confirm you're ready for cross-region traffic shift.

ops-oncall: Ready. We'll keep a 5m hold after each slice increase. Rollback play: abort traffic increase and pin to previous variant, then scale down new pods.

elaine: Pls note autoscale warm pool for US needs a brief 12m lead to spin up extra instances for slice 2. I'll kick that at +10m.

maria: Reminder: update release notes with known minor tokenization drift and suggested prompt tweaks. Adding bullet now.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 start: service=frontend variant=v2.4.1-rlz region=us slice=1/10 timestamp=3334445587

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 1 health after 6m: error-rate=0.9%, p95=480ms, successful=true

sahil: If US slice 1 stays stable for 15m, ramp to slice 2. If any alert fires, we hold and triage.

ops-oncall: Noted. Triage channel= #ops-incident if alerts. Keep me pinged.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU canary complete -> holding at 5% stable for 30m. US slice 2 scheduled in 18m with warm-pool confirm.

elaine: Warm-pool spin request issued for US. Also enabling cache-prefill to reduce cold-start latency for first-wave traffic.

kai: APAC plan: don't open to traffic until US reaches 50% and no regressions for 1h. APAC warm-pool standby at 20% until then.

maria: Also posting a short note to #release-notes: "v2.4.1-rlz: perf improvements + tokenization minor change; pinned reranker 1.9.0-compat."

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 start: slice=2/10 timestamp=3334445610

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US slice 2 health after 4m: error-rate=1.6% -> ALERT fired to #ops-alerts (threshold 1.5%).

ops-oncall: Received alert. Pausing ramp, holding at slice 2. Sahil, initiating rollback criteria checklist.

elaine: Looking at logs: increased 503s coming from a downstream async worker that's timing out under new traffic pattern. I'll open a quick mitigation to increase worker timeout by 30s.

kai: If mitigation fails in 10m, we execute rollback to v2.3.9 for US slices and notify customers via status page.

sahil: Agreed. Execute mitigation now, ops keep monitoring.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Config change applied: worker.timeout=60s (was 30s) timestamp=3334445618

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Re-eval in 3m: US slice 2 error-rate dropped to 0.8%, p95=520ms. Alert cleared.

ops-oncall: Good recovery. We'll keep slice 2 held for 20m before ramping. No rollback needed.

sahil: Final: continue staggered US ramp after hold, APAC remains on warm-standby until US >=50% for 1h. Thanks all — callout in release notes about the worker timeout mitigation and reranker pin. :thumbsup:
